# Sophie Lin

> Personal portfolio site for Sophie Lin, a software engineering student/practitioner.

The site is a single-page portfolio covering:
- Home / introduction
- Projects (software engineering projects including LAAS, SEAS, ADAS, GATC, and others)
- Experience (internships and work history)
- Gallery (photos from GSEF, Global Ties Detroit, TechGirls, and other events)
- Contact

GitHub: https://github.com/sophieclin
